title: The user sends a second ask while the agent is still on the first
expected: A recap opened right after the second message shows neither ask as not addressed: the agent is still working. After the turn both are recorded and done.

steps.user: Rename the Account page to Profile everywhere.

steps.agent: Renaming the page component and its route first.

steps.user: also update the nav link and the sitemap while you're there

check.why: the agent is still working; a request it has only just been sent is not overlooked
nothing here is for the user to do

steps.agent: The Account page is now Profile: the component, the route, the nav link and the sitemap all say Profile.

check.why: nothing the user asked for is left unaddressed
the request sent mid-turn is recorded
the rename is recorded as done
